entry.title: U.S. Navy Commissions Flight III Destroyer USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128) in Alaska
entry.summary: The U.S. Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar and Aegis Baseline 10, during a ceremony in Whittier, Alaska. The U.S. Navy placed its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer, USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128), into active commission today during a formal ceremony in Whittier, Alaska. The commissioning of USS Ted Stevens marks an immediate, decisive leap in naval warfighting readiness and surface fleet lethality. 关键事实：Navy has officially commissioned the USS Ted Stevens (DDG 128)；its newest Flight III Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer equipped with the SPY-6 radar；Aegis Baseline 10

entry.title: Germany's Merz arrives in Kyiv to pledge more support
entry.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv, on Sunday morning, accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche and a delegation of leading German economic figures. Merz is also expected to unveil plans for the co-production of interceptor drones and long-range missiles both in Ukraine and Germany. Merz is expected to emphasize how Germany also stands to benefit from the expanded cooperation, both in terms of its own defense against Russian hybrid activities and in terms of jobs and technology. 关键事实：German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in the Ukrainian capital；on Sunday morning；accompanied by Economy Minister Katherina Reiche

entry.title: Russia hits second major bridge in Ukraine's capital Kyiv
entry.summary: A Russian strike has hit a second major bridge in Kyiv, Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko has said, as Moscow ramps up attacks on critical infrastructure in Ukraine's capital. The Kremlin leader admitted Kyiv had "got some results" from its refinery attacks and Russia had lost about 1% of its GDP. Ukraine maintains it began attacking Russian oil infrastructure because it helps the Kremlin finance the war. 关键事实：A Russian strike has hit a second major bridge in Kyiv；Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko has said；as Moscow ramps up attacks on critical infrastructure in Ukraine's capital

entry.title: OpenAI safety employee resigns, claiming the company’s ‘culture is broken’
entry.summary: In an essay published in The Atlantic, Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches. He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI, he is “among the longest-tenured employees at the company.” Now he’s quitting, because in his view, the company’s “culture is broken.” But in Robinson’s view, the debate needs to go beyond “specific rules or new laws,” addressing the overall culture at these companies. 关键事实：In an essay published in The Atlantic；Robinson said he led the writing of safety reports that accompanied OpenAI’s major product launches；He also said that with three-and-a-half years at OpenAI
